title: VAT Standard Rates Across the East African Community, 2026
description: Standard VAT rates across EAC member states as of 2026. Kenya maintains the lowest standard rate in the community at 16%, versus 18% in Uganda, Tanzania, Rwanda and Burundi.
attribution: SmartVAT Kenya (smartvatkenya.co.ke), compiled from member-state revenue authority publications and EAC documentation.

records.notes: Lowest in the EAC. Zero-rated and exempt lists are extensive (VAT Act First and Second Schedules).
URA administration; e-invoicing via EFRIS since 2021 — the cautionary benchmark for Kenya's CETIS plans.
TRA administration; electronic fiscal devices mandated for registered suppliers.
